# Examples: no-framework backends

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_examples_gallery.py; edit the examples, not this. -->

Web apps, workers, scripts, serverless, deploy. Back to the [Examples gallery](../examples.md). Files here: 16.

| File | Shows | Install | Run | Docs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `examples/backend_celery.py` | Celery: tasks call tools through run_sync; an approval parks between two tasks. | `pip install agent-adapter celery` | import only | [Celery](../backends/celery.md) |
| `examples/backend_common.py` | The service layer the backend examples share: tools, one Executor per process, approvals. | `pip install agent-adapter` | import only | [FastAPI](../backends/fastapi.md) |
| `examples/backend_django.py` | Django in one file: async views await the service, sync views use run_sync, tools beside it. | `pip install "agent-adapter[server]" django` | `python examples/backend_django.py` (starts a server on :8000) | [Django](../backends/django.md) |
| `examples/backend_fastapi.py` | FastAPI: one Executor per process, async routes, approvals over HTTP, the tool server mounted. | `pip install "agent-adapter[server]" fastapi` | `python examples/backend_fastapi.py` (starts a server on :8000) | [FastAPI](../backends/fastapi.md) |
| `examples/backend_flask.py` | Flask: one Executor per process, run_sync in sync views, the tool server under /agent. | `pip install "agent-adapter[server-wsgi]" flask` | `python examples/backend_flask.py` (starts a server on :8000) | [Flask](../backends/flask.md) |
| `examples/backend_loop_runner.py` | A warm sync process (Lambda, Dramatiq, gRPC sync servicer): one loop, clients kept warm. | `pip install agent-adapter` | `python examples/backend_loop_runner.py` | [Runtime](../concepts/runtime.md) |
| `examples/backend_notebook.py` | Notebooks and apps: Jupyter awaits, Streamlit reruns call run_sync, Gradio handlers await. | `pip install agent-adapter` | import only | [Notebooks and apps](../backends/notebooks.md) |
| `examples/backend_other_asgi.py` | Other frameworks: mount the ASGI tool server, or call ToolService from aiohttp and gRPC. | `pip install "agent-adapter[server]" aiohttp` | import only | [Other web frameworks](../backends/other-asgi.md) |
| `examples/backend_pipeline.py` | Pipelines: build the executor on the worker, then call tools from tasks, UDFs and actors. | `pip install agent-adapter` | import only | [Data pipelines](../backends/pipelines.md) |
| `examples/backend_queue.py` | Queues: one `handle_envelope` for async consumers, sync job runners and Temporal activities. | `pip install agent-adapter` | import only | [Queues and consumers](../backends/queues.md) |
| `examples/backend_script.py` | Scripts and batch jobs: argparse, run_sync, one batch through run_many, exit codes. | `pip install agent-adapter` | `python examples/backend_script.py` | [Scripts and batch jobs](../backends/scripts.md) |
